arguments.name: Animation Animatic Probes
arguments.description: Check-tier gate on the animatic render step: the rendered frame sequence passes every episode-tier probe (C26–C30 and C12): twos/ones split, hold band, screen time per beat, eye trace, loop closure in line phases, colour pair per beat, byte-identical double render.
arguments.subject: animation-animatic-probes
arguments.guidance: Ground truth by exit code (D81). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-all.py out/animatic-seq --timeline v3/timeline.json --xsheet v3/xsheet.json --second-frames out/animatic-seq-b --subset` in the renderer root and passes only when every check it prints passes; its first printed line is its positive control and it refuses to report if the control does not trip. One line per probe: name · pass/fail · control. On FAIL quote the probe's own line naming the frame or beat and fix the contract or the render, never the probe. Control: each probe trips its own fixture control (scripts/animation/fixtures).
